newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-VILLANOVA'S THOMAS TO ENTER NBA DRAFT.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-VILLANOVA'S THOMAS TO ENTER NBA DRAFT.

text.p: Forward Tim Thomas announced Thursday he will leave Villanova University, forgoing his final three years of his eligibility to enter the NBA Draft.
Thomas, the 16th underclassman to enter the draft, is the only college player to declare his NBA intentions after completing just one year.

The 6-10 (2.08 m), 230-pound (104 kg) Thomas, who figures to be selected anywhere from third to eighth in the draft, is a versatile as well as talented player who is comfortable playing just about any position on the court.
Thomas averaged 16.9 points and 6.0 rebounds with Villanova this season. He was the Big East Rookie of the Year and was selected Freshman of the Year by the U.S. Basketball Writers.
The Wildcats finished 24-10 and lost in the second round of the East Region in the NCAA Tournament to California.
